comparison_notes: Authored oracle, not extractor output. Feed only numbered documents and openapi.json to the builder; exclude all oracles and README files.

Use scripts/check_synthetic_ir.project conventions: outcome reason lists and holiday/note/prohibited-word sets are unordered; identity order, attempt order and exact mandatory wording are significant.

Ask-text paraphrases, band names, free-form triggers and source spans require semantic review and are not exact-match checks. Different equivalent special-case action representations require manual review.
Expect no unresolved rules. An extractor marking any effective rule unresolved must report it rather than silently defaulting.
Product response-field mappings and renamed operation inputs live in OpenAPI, not PolicyIR; expected-api.json is their separate oracle.
